notes.title: Patch 1.3.0: The Weeping Song + 33% off!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, RadiantArin here with another update to the game.

Patch 1.3.0 brings the epic conclusion to the game with its biggest and final update: The Weeping Song. In it, journey to the newly reformed Gestalt Empire in search of an Umbra. In a land where technology reigns supreme, the scattered pollution and destructive landscape has awoken new life in many of the monstrosities that inhabit Gestalt. There is more than meets the eye to this adventure, however, as a menace lurks beneath the shadows of the Umbra.

New weapons, armors, and items are available in the update, and Gestalt Empire's [i]Machina Wastes [/i]comes with scaling enemies that scale with how far you are in the game. You can get to the Gestalt Kingdom from Amalthea after completing Chapter 3.

Aside from the Side Quest update, there has been some balancing of late game weaponry.

[b]Old Queen Sword[/b]: Reduced Critical Multiplier from 3x to 2x.
[b]Violent Rose[/b]: Reduced Critical Multiplier from 3x to 2x.

There has also been some balancing done to certain skills in the game:

[b]LILAC[/b]:

[b]Nightmare Bloom[/b]: Before, this skill used to say that it would put an opponent to Sleep and lower DEF. This skill made it possible so you can infinitely put an opponent to Sleep and trivializes the game. This has been fixed to say "Puts Quantum status on an enemy and lowers DEF."

[b]Valkyrie Comet[/b]: The scaling of this skill has been decreased.

[b]RUBELLUM[/b]:

[b]Vexing Flow[/b]: The overall damage of this skill has been increased.

[b]Assassinate EX[/b]: The cooldown of this skill has been put on again.

[b]SNOW[/b]:

[b]Predator Arrow[/b]: This skill was previously listed as a Physical Attack skill, and not an Absorb skill. This has been fixed.

With the new update coming out, the game will also [u]be on sale for 33% off during the week of 08/12 to 08/19[/u]. This is your chance to pick up the game for a better deal so don't miss out!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 has been released!
notes.content:
Another update and a small fix to a big problem.

The Quest to start Lilac's quest, When Petals Fall, now actually starts after completing Chapter 2. The trigger was set wrong and a quick hotfix was able to put the trigger back to its proper activation.

Along with that, there have been some sound and visual redesigns for some cave maps:

• Relhall Caves
• Umbra Cave
• Clockwork Ruins
• Seaside Cove

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 + Steam Summer Sale News!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Patch 1.2.0 has been released. When Petals Fall, the great lilac flower will open its bud, and brace itself for the doom of the world.

This update introduces a new character to the roster: Lilac. Lilac is a very technical fighter that relies on Luck to boost stats. She also has a wide variety of buffs and debuffs that affect the enemy party. We hope that Lilac will be a welcome addition to the Umbra armada throughout your journey.

Along with that, a few new things have been added with Patch 1.2.0.

• A few new skits.
• More balance passes regarding characters.
• One new enemy fight.
• Polishing some dialogue.

In preparation for this update, the game will also go on sale during the Steam Summer sale at 50% off from June 25 to July 9th! This is your chance to grab the game if you haven't already and to experience all the new content the game has to offer.

Again, bugfixes will be corrected as they come up. If you want to get in touch with me, Discord is the fastest way to do so.


https://discord.gg/7JkZ9tD

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today I'll be bringing a new update to Even For Eternia that balances out a lot of weapons in the game.

It is through my understanding that the weapons you get throughout the game, whether it be Bronze, Silver, Obsidian, Emerald, or Mythril weapons, eventually outclass other weapons in the game due to their scaling Attack and Magic Attack bonuses. To compensate, some of the other weapons in the game have had their stats increased, like the Snake Kopis, Tiger Fang, Archon Rod, Elven Blade, Heat Sword, and Heat Dagger. Hopefully, this opens up a bit of variety with different combinations of weapons and the general consensus moves from "Bronze, Silver, Obsidian, Emerald, and Mythril weapons are the best."

Nextly, Patch 1.1.0 introduces a few new skits and cutscenes. These will all take place after completing Chapter 5. As always, bugs and glitches are bound to happen, so please bring any of them to my attention on the Steam page or through my Discord server, found below.

Thank you, and have a wonderful day.

https://discord.gg/7JkZ9tD

notes.title: Bugfixes and patch notes.
notes.content:
Hey there, everyone! A new patch for the game has just been released for the game. Patch 1.0.1 introduces a few hotfix bugs that some of you have already gotten in touch with me about. I have also cleaned up a bit of the code in a hope to make the game run smoother.

Just to detail a list of bugs that were reported:

• Passability issues in the Adrastea Forest.
• Missing Quest.
• Passability issues which prevented you from getting a Treasure Chest in Adrastea.
• Transfer issues in Mt. Ophelia.
• The Side Quest "The Hunted" was bugged. This has been fixed.

Once again, if you have any bugs or issues with the game, join the Discord below, as it is the most effective means of communication to getting through to me.

https://discord.gg/7JkZ9tD
